notes.body:
1st  payment     :   10% of selling price Upon LOI Execution [Refund to the buyer]  
2nd  payment    :   30% [Bank Guarantee] of selling price Upon Purchase Agreement Execution
3rd  payment     :  100% of selling price Upon Title Deed(s) Transfer 
                             [30-45 Day after purchase agreement execution]

- Registration fees (2%)             : Half pay (Seller 1% | Buyer 1%)
- Corporate income tax (1%)      : Half pay (Seller 0.5% | Buyer 0.5%)
- Speci c business tax (3.3%)     : Half pay (Seller 1.65% | Buyer 1.65%)
